baseline.ageOrigin: set age zero on the newly constructed homogeneous pre-main-sequence starting model; no later reset or fixed ZAMS offset
baseline.initialModelSource: fresh construction for each trial, no bundled or cross-trial saved model
baseline.microscopicDiffusion: four-class diffusion and heating from pinned solar example
baseline.EOS: pinned MESA defaults without custom override
baseline.rateOverrides: none; resolve and retain installed dependency hashes before launch

calibrationParameters.boundInterpretation: preregistered search domain, not observational confidence intervals

fit.referenceConvention: nominal L=3.828e26 W and R=6.957e8 m; historical GS98 Z/X=0.02292
fit.toleranceInterpretation: numerical fitting accuracy to declared conventional targets, not observational sigma
fit.objective: sum over L,R,Z/X of ((model/target - 1)/1e-4)^2; optimization only, no chi-square p-value
fit.TeffRole: derived consistency, not independent fit term
fit.heldOutUse: not consulted to retune a frozen attempt

numericalPolicy.otherObservablesChangeLimit: 0.1 times frozen observational marginal uncertainty; absent uncertainty blocks admission
numericalPolicy.profiles: common resolved radial support, fixed interpolation; no extrapolated core or surface acceptance
numericalPolicy.unconvergedOrResourceLimited: incomplete, preserve evidence, no automatic tolerance relaxation
